key_idea: Read the top of each tower on the ruler, then subtract.
steps: The top of the orange tower is at 15 on the ruler, the short mark between 14 and 16.
The top of the blue tower is at 9, the short mark between 8 and 10.

choice_feedback.A: Count again on the ruler: 15 - 9 = 6, not 5.
choice_feedback.C: 9 is the height of the blue tower, not the difference.
choice_feedback.D: 15 is the height of the orange tower, not the difference.
choice_feedback.E: 24 is 15 + 9. We need to take away, not add.
